notes.title: Update for November 13, 2022
notes.notes:
This update for Mezzanine includes 

[list]
[*] Improved navigation and better hotspots on interactive regions
[*] Bug fixes including multiple coffee mugs appearing and coffee machine not being triggered
[*] Added in new items, including a camera 
[*] New hover icons to indicate possible actions 
[/list]

notes.title: Stuck in the Mezz? Introducing the Zentropy Customer Service Line
notes.notes: Can't find your way to the Wellness Center? Unable to upgrade your PsyPal? In collaboration with Zirkadia's Communi-Tek division, we now present to you the Zentropy Customer Service Hotline. Players can call or text +1 (415) 326 9222 with their questions.
